mechanics.definition: 同一画像作用域内，每次结算使用固定轴数和固定有效格坐标集合；既可为规则矩形，也可为各轴高度不同但不随结算变化的固定不规则布局。

conditional_packages.when: 同时命中settlement.ways与settlement.effective-ways-capacity，固定有效格布局下的实际Ways容量仍逐盘变化

evidence_signatures: all eligible board snapshots have the same valid visible coordinate set within the sealed scope
rectangular layouts use rows directly; fixed irregular layouts additionally seal fixed_height_by_reel and one fixed_valid_cell_layout_id
each valid visible cell resolves to exactly one declared visible symbol_id at every eligible board phase
generator_partitions and stack_axis are explicitly investigated; absent semantics are recorded as the controlled value none
exclusions: reel height or valid-cell layout varies inside the same sealed scope
presentation-only frames that do not participate in settlement

mechanics.definition: 同一画像作用域内，实际可见轴高、有效格坐标集合或参与结算的几何布局会按已定义规则在结算之间变化。

conditional_packages.when: ways_capacity_mode=layout_plus_non_layout；最终实际Ways容量同时受几何布局与Split Symbol、超大符号或多重计数等非几何规则影响

evidence_signatures: eligible board snapshots contain more than one proven reel-height or valid-cell coordinate pattern
protocol or settlement output exposes the actual participating layout for each board
each valid visible cell resolves to exactly one declared visible symbol_id at every eligible board phase
ways_capacity_mode is sealed as none, layout_only, or layout_plus_non_layout
layout_capacity_projection_bindings, when Ways capacity is relevant, maps every active layout label of the selected geometry Owner to one positive geometry base capacity with a sealed rule hash
layout_plus_non_layout additionally binds one settlement.effective-ways-capacity node that reproduces final actual capacity from geometry and non-layout inputs
generator_partitions and stack_axis are explicitly investigated; absent semantics are recorded as the controlled value none
exclusions: only the visual frame changes while valid settlement cells remain fixed
a fixed grid marketed under a variable-ways brand without actual layout variation
valid-cell layout is fixed and only Split Symbol, oversized-symbol multiplicity, symbol multi-counting, or another non-layout rule changes effective Ways capacity
